"""
URL: https://leetcode.com/problems/reformat-date/description/?envType=problem-list-v2&envId=vn57k9wr

1507. Reformat Date

Given a date string in the form Day Month Year, where:

- Day is in the set {"1st", "2nd", "3rd", "4th", ..., "30th", "31st"}.
- Month is in the set {"Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun", "Jul", "Aug", "Sep", "Oct", "Nov", "Dec"}.
- Year is in the range [1900, 2100].

Convert the date string to the format YYYY-MM-DD, where:

- YYYY denotes the 4 digit year.
- MM denotes the 2 digit month.
- DD denotes the 2 digit day.

Example 1:

Input: date = "20th Oct 2052"
Output: "2052-10-20"

Example 2:

Input: date = "6th Jun 1933"
Output: "1933-06-06"

Example 3:

Input: date = "26th May 1960"
Output: "1960-05-26"

Constraints:

- The given dates are guaranteed to be valid, so no error handling is necessary.
"""


class Solution:
    def reformatDate(self, date: str) -> str:
        month_map = {
            "Jan": "01",
            "Feb": "02",
            "Mar": "03",
            "Apr": "04",
            "May": "05",
            "Jun": "06",
            "Jul": "07",
            "Aug": "08",
            "Sep": "09",
            "Oct": "10",
            "Nov": "11",
            "Dec": "12",
        }
        day_str, month_str, year_str = date.split()
        # Remove suffix from day (last two characters)
        day_num = day_str[:-2]
        # Pad day with leading zero if needed
        day_num = day_num.zfill(2)
        month_num = month_map[month_str]
        return f"{year_str}-{month_num}-{day_num}"


sol = Solution()

print(sol.reformatDate("20th Oct 2052"))  # "2052-10-20"

assert sol.reformatDate("20th Oct 2052") == "2052-10-20"
assert sol.reformatDate("6th Jun 1933") == "1933-06-06"
assert sol.reformatDate("26th May 1960") == "1960-05-26"

assert sol.reformatDate("1st Jan 1900") == "1900-01-01"
assert sol.reformatDate("31st Dec 2100") == "2100-12-31"
assert sol.reformatDate("2nd Feb 2000") == "2000-02-02"
assert sol.reformatDate("3rd Mar 1999") == "1999-03-03"
assert sol.reformatDate("4th Apr 2020") == "2020-04-04"
assert sol.reformatDate("5th May 2010") == "2010-05-05"
assert sol.reformatDate("6th Jun 1980") == "1980-06-06"
assert sol.reformatDate("7th Jul 1970") == "1970-07-07"
assert sol.reformatDate("8th Aug 1965") == "1965-08-08"
assert sol.reformatDate("9th Sep 1955") == "1955-09-09"
assert sol.reformatDate("10th Oct 1945") == "1945-10-10"
assert sol.reformatDate("11th Nov 1935") == "1935-11-11"
